8.3.6.3 EcuM_AbortWakeupAlarm
[SWS_EcuM_04061] Definition of API function EcuM_AbortWakeupAlarm
Upstream requirements: SRS_ModeMgm_00016
⌈
Service Name
EcuM_AbortWakeupAlarm
Syntax
Std_ReturnType EcuM_AbortWakeupAlarm (
EcuM_UserType user
)
Service ID [hex]
0x24
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant
Parameters (in)
user
The user that wants to cancel the wakeup alarm.
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: The service has succeeded
E_NOT_OK: The service failed
ECUM_E_NOT_ACTIVE: No owned alarm found
Description
Ecum_AbortWakeupAlarm aborts the wakeup alarm previously set by this user. EcuM_Abort
WakeupAlarm is part of the ECU Manager Module port interface.
Available via
EcuM.h
⌋
